## Sep 13 Results: The Numbers Tell the Story

Let me break down yesterday's performance by the numbers. We went 10-5 across the slate, hitting 66.7% accuracy. That's above our target threshold and represents solid value for bettors who followed the model.

## Game-by-Game Breakdown

Here's how each pick performed. Notice our highest confidence picks at 63% all delivered—the Jays, Brewers miss notwithstanding, and the Rays hit perfectly. The correlation between confidence level and outcome was strong yesterday.

## Key Statistical Insights

The three misses came on picks ranging from 53% to 63% confidence. That Brewers miss at 63% hurts, but variance is part of the game. More importantly: our picks above 60% went 5-2 (71.4%), while picks below 60% went 5-3 (62.5%). The model's calibration is performing as expected.

## Sep 14 Preview: Tomorrow's Top Pick

Moving to September 14th. The model has identified the Dodgers at the Reds as our highest confidence play at 63%. Here's what the numbers say about this matchup.

## Pitcher Matchup Analysis

Tarik Skubal brings elite numbers to the mound for Los Angeles. We're looking at a pitcher who creates favorable odds in any matchup. Nick Lodolo counters for Cincinnati, but the statistical edge clearly favors the Dodgers' offense against his profile.

At 63% confidence, this matches our strongest picks from yesterday—the same confidence level that delivered with the Jays and Rays. When the model speaks this loudly, the data tells us to listen.

## The Bottom Line

Sep 13: 10-5, 66.7%. Sep 14: Dodgers at 63% leading the slate. The model continues to identify value, and the numbers back it up. See you after tomorrow's results.

— Stan
